name: Black Dragon 46
author: lenin55
description: Pill dark teal checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, opacity becomes 0.04, opacity becomes 0.16. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #000000 to #018786, border-color becomes #018786, border-color becomes #fff. On focus, opacity becomes 0.12, opacity becomes 0.16.
